title: Chapter 221 The Battle For The Village Construction Order Ends
content:
Chapter 221 The Battle For The Village Construction Order Ends

[100 lords in Dahuai Domain have successfully synthesized the golden village order. Congratulations to all players for successfully surviving until the end of the battle for the village order. ]

[The current comprehensive strength ranking of Changping County is now announced. ]

10th place: Baiyang Village (Yang Zeshan).

9th place: Tian Village (Yoshida Mondo).

8th place: Wu'an Village (Fang Kai).

7th place: Black Sea Fleet (Liu Dahai).

6th place: Jiuyang Village (Zhang Yang).

5th place: Wild Wolf Gang (Zhuge Kewei).

4th place: Tianba Village (Ye Tianba).

3rd place: Tiejianmen (Ni Wu).

2nd place: Jiuyuan Village (Su Xiu).

1st place: Wana Village (Wang Shuo).

Wang Shuo's heart trembled. He had just synthesized the golden village order.

The battle for the village order was over. He really caught the last train!

Although he was the last one to synthesize the golden village order, he was the first in Changping County. It was very good. Wang Shuo was very happy.

After looking at the rankings, Wang Shuo found that Zhang Yang was ranked sixth.

So he sent him a message and asked: "Zhang Yang, have you synthesized the Golden Village Building Order?"

"Brother, do you think the Golden Village Building Order is so easy to synthesize? But you are the first in Changping County, can you teach me?"

It seems that there are not many people in Changping County who have the Golden Village Building Order.

That Su Xiu has always been closely following him in the rankings. It is very likely that he has synthesized the Golden Village Building Order. He is a strong enemy!

"Sure, just kill more monsters, gather more people, and get more resources..."

"Stop, brother, it's easy for you to say that. It's easy to get people, but I can't afford it!"

"Okay, just ignore me."

Wang Shuo frowned, and then asked: "Which town are you near?"

"Brother, you don't want to attack me?"

"You think too much! I'm just near Nanshan Market, and I don't seem to have heard of you. A village that can make the list should not be unknown."

"Okay, I'm near Xiaochi Town."

Wang Shuo opened the map and found that Xiaochi Town was still a little far away from Nanshan Market.

[Changping County Chat Channel]

"This Wang Shuo is the first again. It seems that the territory has developed well. Why don't we go to him!"

"With someone like you, how can they look down on you?"

Yoshida Mondo: "Baga, I will kill him sooner or later. He dares to bully my people!"

"Boss Su Xiu is also very powerful. I heard that he is handsome and powerful. Are there any sisters who go to him together? If you can become the wife of the village chief, you will win!"

"If you want to be the wife of the village chief, you must also be the first lady! Let's go to Wana Village and try our luck!"

Wang Shuo: "Wana Village welcomes all kinds of talents to come and join us. Whether you are a friend who likes to fight or a friend who doesn't like fighting and killing, Wana Village has a place for you!"

Wang Shuo finally successfully launched an advertisement. He had failed to get his popularity several times before.

At this time, Wang Shuo noticed that the rankings on the personal strength list, the territory strength list, and the gang strength list had also changed.

Of course, the most important thing is the comprehensive strength list, which has the highest gold content.

Then, Lord Zak announced another list.

[Hedong County Comprehensive Strength List]

10th place: Jiuyuan Village.

…

5th place: Wana Village.

4th place: Baihe Village.

3rd place: Wuding Village.

2nd place: Sanyang Village.

1st place: Dongshi Village.

Seeing this ranking, the smile on Wang Shuo's face gradually disappeared.
